name: STUDIO MA 間
tagline: A Tokyo product-design studio portfolio — restraint as the work

brief.name: Studio Ma
brief.industry: A Tokyo industrial/product-design studio portfolio — household objects, electronics, and exhibition work, plus a short studio philosophy
brief.audience: Design directors, manufacturers, and press in Japan and abroad evaluating the studio for product commissions; design-literate, detail-sensitive. Japanese + English.
brief.references: MUJI, Naoto Fukasawa, nendo, note.com, Kinokuniya; ma (間) negative space
brief.context: Bilingual Japanese + English using Noto Sans JP paired with a clean Latin grotesque. Generous ma (negative space), exact alignment, fine hairlines, near-monochrome with one restrained accent. Sections: a spare hero (studio name + one line), selected works (large quiet images, minimal captions), the studio philosophy, clients/press, and a plain contact. A single hanko-style mark is the only ornament.
brief.avoid: Cherry-blossom / torii / neon-Tokyo clichés. Kawaii defaults. Busy layouts. Drop-shadow card slop. Sakura pink as a theme. Loud motion.
